definitions.short: a lion (properly, a lioness as the fiercer (although not a roarer;))
definitions.full: H3833. labiy ' [ לְבִי ] noun [masculine, feminine] lion ; — only plural and figurative of foes לְבָאִם בְּתוֺךְ נַפְשִׁי Psa 57:5 ; of Assyrians לִבְאֹתָ֑יו Nahum 2:13 (|| גֹּרֹתָיו ; suffix reference to אַרְיֵה ). לְבִיָּא noun feminine lioness (on format see Lag BN 93 ); — Ezek 19:2 (|| אֲרָיוֺת ) figurative of mother of Israel לָבִיא noun [masculine] lion , possibly also [ feminine ] lioness (compare Arabic usage, and Gen 49:9 ; Num 24:9 ; Job 4:11 , etc.; but this by no means certain); — ׳ל absolute Gen 49:9-10 t.; — Isa 30:6 (|| לַיִשׁ ), Job 38:39 (|| כְּפִיר ); Gen 49:9 in simile of victor's repose ( רָבַץ ; || אַרְיֵה ), compare Num 24:9 (with שָׁכַב ; || אֲרִי ), Deut 33:20 ( וְטָרַף שָׁכֵן ); see also Num 23:24 ( קוּם ; || אֲרִי ); figurative of Nineveh Nahum 2:12 (|| אַרְיֵה ), compare Isa 5:29 ( שָֽׁאֲגָה in simile; || כְּפִירִים ); figurative of wicked Job 4:11 (+ לַיִשׁ כְּפִיר, שָׁ֑חַל, אַרְיֵה, 4:10 ; 4:11 ); simile of ׳י , devouring ( אָכַל ) in judgment Hosea 13:8 ; figurative of locusts ל ׳מְתַלְּעוֺת Joel 1:6 (|| אַרְיֵה שִׁנֵּי ).
definitions.rootNote: or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא ; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים ; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת ; from an unused root meaning to roar ; compare 738

occurrences.englishText: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness.
He couched, he lay down as a lion,
The old lion perishes for lack of prey.
“Can you hunt the prey for the lioness,
Be exalted, God, above the heavens!
Their roaring will be like a lioness.
The burden of the animals of the South.
I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs,
For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number.
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.

“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
